'''August 2000 Huntsville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Huntsville, AL on 12 August 2000. It is known from Tom Culpepper's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1113">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-12-the-deep-huntsvile-al-8-12-00d1113/ the-deep-huntsvile-al-8-12-00], DeckTech (Tom "Gand" Culpepper, 12 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-12-the-deep-huntsvile-al-8-12-00d1113/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Huntsville, AL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
